text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has come to a close.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nice work, El. You've made a lot of progress this summer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Right, let's head back to Tracen Academy, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ofofofo!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?! What's wrong with your voice, Pearl?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That was odd. Let me try again…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: OFOFOFO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So it wasn't just my imagination. Her voice has become undeniably hoarse, for which there can only be one reason.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You think it's the super spicy death sauce that did this?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I knew she had used too much. She should probably avoid doing any karaoke sessions for a while too, since her voice is shot.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pearl, you sound like an alien. It's kinda funny!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Could you say "We come in peace" for me? Pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You want me to do an alien impression? Haha, fine, I'll give it a shot. I'll try and do one of the aliens they caught at Hangar 18.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey there, people of the solar system! Surrender to me or watch as I smash Pearl's Comet into your measly planet!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ofofofo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Well, all things considered, that was a decent enough impression. The three of us continue to chat away until…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I heard that you're entering the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's not entirely decided yet, but I might be. It's one of the paths I can use to go global, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is that so? In that case, we'll be rivals. I'm running in it too, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It makes me glad to know we'll be able to race together again.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, me too! Just make sure you don't let your guard down, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You may be a member of the lovely Pearl family, but that doesn't mean I'll go easy on you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ofofofo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: O-of course… I understand. But…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I hope you hurry up and get your voice back. It's difficult to take you seriously when you sound like that. Ahaha…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her hoarse laugh does ruin her serious image a little. As for these warm and friendly exchanges… Today will be the last day for them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting tomorrow, we'll be busy preparing for the Rose Stakes.
